mechanism_narrative: A low effective federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is continuous: lower FEDFUNDS values predict higher returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2.0% but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% signals inflationary pressure that leads to central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0% but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1800.0 thousand units) indicates a strong labor market and robust housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE < 5.0% AND HOUST > 1800.0) is met but 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by quarterly GDP growth exceeding 3.0% and unemployment rate below 4.5%), the economy is overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending monetary tightening.
failure_condition: The regime condition (GDPC1 QoQ growth > 3.0% AND UNRATE < 4.5%) is met but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115.0 (2017=100) indicates a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 115.0 but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The relationship is continuous: higher RSAFS values predict higher returns.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 300000.0 but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate central bank intervention and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5% but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1800.0 thousand units signals weak housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing sector is a key component of the economy.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1800.0 but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
